_doc: Which chat.sock operations travel over the relay (unified chat spec §6.4, final review I2). relay maps each engine op to the hub's action kind (attach goes as the sealed chat_attachment upload, no action kind); not_on_relay is answered by the phone itself (RelayChatClient.localAnswer). Read by Go internal/hub/actions/handlers (TestChatRelayOps_EveryEngineOpIsRoutedOrListed) and by the phone (RelayChatClientTests.testRelayOpsContract). A new engine op goes in one of the two lists.
